notes: CHM7 operating temperature -5 C to +55 C in 1830 GX G42; CHM7X operating temperature +5 C to +40 C in 1830 GX G31/G32. Transport and storage -40 C to +70 C. Power 258W (CHM7) and 250W (CHM7X) is for 2x1.2 Tb/s typical excluding client pluggables. Line data rate 200 Gb/s to 1200 Gb/s in 100 Gb/s increments. Baud 68 to 140+ GBaud with increments 0.1 GBaud (lower) to 0.7 GBaud (higher). Roll-off configurable 0.1% to 100% in 0.1% increments; 2% optimal in most scenarios. Chromatic dispersion tolerance >800,000 ps/nm at 68 GBaud and >300,000 ps/nm at 140 GBaud. Reach values stated as 1.2 Tb/s to 400+ km, 1 Tb/s to 1,500+ km, 800 Gb/s to 3,000+ km, 600 Gb/s to 5,500+ km terrestrial. SOP rotation tolerance up to 20 Mrad/s mode dependent. Spectrum widths: Extended C 4.8 THz, Super C 6.1 THz, Extended L 4.8 THz, Super L 5.5 THz. Wavelength tuning 50 MHz increments.
provenance_datasheet_sections: Leverage the latest 5-nm/140 GBaud coherent technology with ICE7
Reduce cost, power consumptionand footprint by ~30%-40%
Boost fiber capacity with Super C, L-band and Super L
Optimize spectral efficiency with a continuously tunable baud rate
suggestions: Schema temp_min_c/temp_max_c could not hold distinct CHM7 vs CHM7X without duplicate objects or product-qualified fields. Consider product_variant on environmental fields. SOP rotation (Mrad/s) and spectrum bandwidth (THz) are major line-side specs not in schema.
